content:
Use uploaded storyboard as exact visual and timing reference. Create a cinematic 15-second IMAX 8K realistic sports commercial — World Cup 2026 final, massive night stadium, 80,000 fans, floodlights, confetti.
Hero: jersey number 10, the player nobody noticed all tournament — consistent face and kit throughout. Camera work in early action scenes must feel intentionally slightly late, as if the operator keeps almost missing him.
Open with tournament montage — hero always on pitch, cameras always on others. Final whistle: push-in on face, something shifts. Body feint USA — camera slightly late pan. Heel roll Belgium. 360 Argentina — orbit only just catches it. France spin. Norway nutmeg — commentator says his name for the first time ever. Brazil GK set — he chips, camera late, ball already in the air. Ball hits net. Every camera turns to him at once. He stands still, calm. Trophy lift. Commentator says full name correctly. Stadium chants it. He smiles.
Camera: ARRI Alexa 35, 24fps, 1/48 shutter, anamorphic flares, shallow DOF, intentionally slightly late camera pans in early action, ground-level tracking, fast whip-pans, speed ramps, 0.2x slo-mo chip, all-cameras-turn moment, final crane rise.
Sound: commentator naming others · ambient crowd · heartbeat · late camera scramble · commentator says his name first time · silence · late camera · net snap · all cameras clicking at once · roar · chant builds · anthem · fireworks · final bass.

以比赛蒙太奇开场——主角总是在场上，摄像机总是对准其他人。终场哨响：推近他的脸，某种变化发生。身体假动作过掉美国——摄像机稍微滞后。脚后跟滚动比利时。360度阿根廷——轨道摄像机勉强捕捉到。法国旋转。挪威穿裆——解说员第一次说出他的名字。巴西门将准备——他挑射，摄像机滞后，球已经在空中。球入网。所有摄像机同时转向他。他静止不动，冷静。举起奖杯。解说员正确地说出全名。体育场高呼他的名字。他微笑。
